class ats_utilities.option.ioption_configurator.IOptionConfigurator(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol, Generic

Defines the IOptionConfigurator abstract class with method(s). Provides an interface for option configuration.

It defines:

methods:
add_operation - Adds an option to the parser.
add_version_operation - Adds version option to the parser.
register_commands - Registers a list of commands with the parser.
